author: aiva64140
quote: Waited thirteen years for this perfect game and honestly, it’s breathtaking, especially when my $100 masterpiece crashes to the dashboard every ten minutes. Leonida looks incredible at a cinematic twelve frames per second, and falling endlessly through the Vice City pavement really adds depth to the open-world experience. Jason and Lucia’s gripping story completely loses momentum whenever mission triggers break. Truly a generational triumph of modern gaming. Easy 0/10, thanks Rockstar.
